notes: GNYC publishes a full-year, department-tagged 'Calendar of Events' (2026) - the most complete conference calendar in the Atlantic Union batch. Department labels on the page (Administration, Youth, Hispanic, Franco-Haitian, Korean, Multi-ethnic, English, Publishing, etc.) are kept as sourceLabel.
The calendar has no per-event links; url points to the calendar page. Times, where shown, were not recorded.

Oct-Dec 2025: the previous WordPress site listed only a handful of department events (3 in Dec 2025); recovered from Wayback captures. The 2025 full-year calendar is not available, so Q4 2025 is under-counted relative to 2026.
Office closures, public holidays, daylight-saving notices, school-closure days and 'appreciation month' notices were excluded as non-events (count in excludedNonEvents).

Recurring meetings (Finance Committee, EXCOM, Ministerial/Departmental Committee, Literature Evangelists team meetings, Ministerial Spouses prayer conferences, Lay Training School sessions, pastors' meetings by language group, etc.) are recorded once with count and dates.

Notable: a 'Fall Evangelism - Impact NY 2026' campaign (26 Sep-4 Oct 2026), Franco-Haitian 'Mega Campaign - Queens' (4-25 Apr 2026) and School of Evangelism, Hispanic Holy Week evangelism and Caravan of Hope, Family Life Evangelistic Campaign, monthly Lay Training School, and five language-group camp meetings (Korean, Luso-Brazilian, English/Multi-ethnic, Franco-Haitian, Hispanic) plus a United Camp Meeting in September.
Gleaner (16 Jan 2026) reports a GNYC hurricane-relief visit to Jamaica after Hurricane Melissa; no date given, so not recorded as an event.
